title: The Indic Token Tax in 2026: Measuring Tokenizer. Disparity and Its Cost for the Languages of India
abstract: arXiv:2611.13058v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Commercial language model APIs bill per token, so a tokenizer that needs more tokens for the same content in one language makes that language more expensive, slower, and able to fit less text in a fixed context window. We measure this disparity for nine public tokenizers, including those of GPT-4, GPT-4o, Qwen2.5, DeepSeek-V3, Mistral-Nemo and four Sarvam models, on all 25 languages of India available in FLORES-200 (2,009 professionally translated sentences aligned with English) and on 13,732 human-translated Hinglish-English social media pairs from PHINC. On GPT-4o's tokenizer the same content needs between 1.57 times (Hindi) and 5.01 times (Odia) the tokens of English, and 13.7 times for Santali in Ol Chiki script; GPT-4's tokenizer needs up to 12.8 times. Sarvam-30B/105B is the only third-party tokenizer that stays below 2.6 times on every language (median 1.53). In an illustrative scenario using official list prices accessed on 5 N

translated_title: 2026年的印度语言“代币税”：测量分词器差异及其对印度各语言的成本
translated_abstract: 商业语言模型API按token计费，因此当分词器处理某种语言的相同内容需要更多token时，就会使该语言的使用更昂贵、速度更慢，并且在固定上下文窗口中能容纳的文本更少。我们在FLORES-200中全部25种印度语言（2,009句与英文对齐的专业翻译句子）以及来自PHINC的13,732对人工翻译的印地英语-英语社交媒体文本上，测量了九个公开分词器的这种差异，包括GPT-4、GPT-4o、Qwen2.5、DeepSeek-V3、Mistral-Nemo以及四个Sarvam模型的分词器。在GPT-4o的分词器上，相同内容所需的token是英语的1.57倍（印地语）到5.01倍（奥里亚语），而使用Ol Chiki文字的桑塔利语高达13.7倍；GPT-4的分词器最高需要12.8倍。Sarvam-30B/105B是唯一在所有语言上都保持在2.6倍以下（中位数1.53）的第三方分词器。在一个使用截至11月5日获取的官方标价的示例场景中……
tldr: 该研究测量了九个主流分词器对印度25种语言的“代币税”，发现印度语言所需token量最高可达英语的13.7倍（GPT-4o分词器），导致印度语言用户在商业LLM使用中面临更高的费用、更慢的速度和更小的有效上下文，而Sarvam分词器是唯一将差异控制在2.6倍以内的第三方选择。
en_tdlr: This study quantifies the "token tax" across nine tokenizers for all 25 languages of India, showing Indian languages require 1.57x–13.7x more tokens than English (e.g., GPT-4o), making them costlier, slower, and context-limited, with Sarvam's tokenizer being the only third-party one staying below 2.6x.
